# Introduction to Information Science, 2nd Edition

## Localization result

Introduction to Information Science, second edition, is represented locally by its detailed public description and table of contents covering the foundations, systems, behaviors, management, ethics, and research methods of information science.

## Core knowledge

- The field map includes the information-science discipline, document history, philosophies of information, paradigms and theories, information, documents, and domain analysis.
- Operational areas include information organization, digital technologies and data systems, information systems, retrieval and analysis, and information management and policy.
- Human and social areas include information behavior, communication contexts, digital literacies, law and ethics, and the information society.
- Research areas include informetrics and research methods in information science.
- The theory-practice relationship and the changing digital information environment connect IM to IS, data science, archives, knowledge management, and digital humanities.
